crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s angel said to Manoah, “Of all that I said to the woman let her beware.

people.name: Manoah
people.line: Father of Samson, from the tribe of Dan.

translations.web: Yahweh’s angel said to Manoah, “Of all that I said to the woman let her beware.
translations.bsb: So the angel of the LORD answered Manoah, “Your wife is to do everything I told her.
translations.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.
translations.asv: And the angel of Jehovah said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.
